title: From scope freeze to the 1.0 launch
subtitle: A five-step roadmap: every node is verifiable on its own; dates are quarterly signals, not promises.

events.name: Scope freeze
events.detail: The feature list is locked; only fixes land after this point.

events.name: Developer preview
events.detail: A private build reaches a hundred seed users with a feedback channel.

events.name: Public beta
events.detail: Registration opens fully and pricing goes public with the docs site.

events.name: Release candidate
events.detail: Signed, reproducible builds are verified end to end before the freeze.

events.name: 1.0 launch
events.detail: The stable release, migration guide, and long-term support ship together.

footer: A milestone starts only after the previous one is accepted; dates are quarterly signals, not promises.
